payload.friendly_name: Deep ROI pass over the large tests/charter suites
payload.purpose_context: A first pass over tests/charter (PR #6483) read only about 40 of 279 files. This mission reviews the large suites function by function and deletes change-detectors, tautologies, mock-only, retired-path and duplicate private-helper tests, naming the covering test for each deletion.
payload.purpose_tldr: Remove low-value charter tests so the suite guards live contracts at lower cost.

options: Strict: delete only with a named covering test; coverage of src/charter must not drop
Consolidate: also merge/parametrize near-duplicates; coverage must not drop
payload.question: How strict is the deletion bar: when a test is redundant, may we delete it only if a named test covers the same behaviour (strict), or also merge or parametrize near-duplicates into a surviving test (consolidate)? And must line coverage of src/charter stay unchanged?

payload.final_answer: Consolidate: delete with a named covering test, and also merge/parametrize near-duplicates into a surviving test; src/charter line coverage must not drop

payload.question: Add a work package for the heaviest tests/charter files that #6485 does not list?

payload.final_answer: Add WP06: review the heaviest unlisted files with the same rubric; a test may also be made cheaper while keeping its contract

payload.wp_title: Remaining parity, schema, cwd and sync files ROI pass
Heavy charter tests: cost and ROI pass
Resolver, cascade, compiler and mission-type suites ROI pass
Packs and org-charter suites ROI pass
